thread:
Olivia: kicking off POC intake for Tempest Health — aiming for a 30-day trial. Can we align on success criteria + blockers before Monday's kickoff?
Olivia: quick context: customer wants RAG for clinical notes + embeddings for search, 200 qps peak, regulated data (HIPAA).
Priya: noted. Who from Tempest will join kickoff? security, infra, and product?
Olivia: customer will bring: CTO (Anna), Head of ML (Raj), Security lead (external), and Product PM (Lina).
Arjun: for scoping I need: sample prompt set (10-20), eval labels for the retrieval task, and a representative traffic profile (qps, avg tokens).
Sam: proposed baseline success metrics:
  - retrieval recall@10 >= 0.78 on their eval set
  - generation accuracy (clinically relevant Q/A) >= 0.85 by human eval
  - p95 gen latency < 300ms (hosted)
  - cost target: < $0.60 per 1k tokens served (POC target)
Arjun: also include stability bars: 95th latency SLO and an error budget for retries/batching.
Dana: security checklist: SSO (SAML/OKTA), data retention window, encryption at rest, and log ingestion policy. We need their infosec questionnaire filled by Thu.
sec-bot: security questionnaire link: https://redwood.company/sec-qa/forms/temppoc-123 (expires in 7 days) :lock:
Priya: pricing options for a 30-day run: hosted credits + evaluation support, or short-term Dedicated (1-week burst) if they need throughput guarantees. I'll confirm numbers after we finish traffic profile.
Olivia: immediate asks to share with customer before kickoff:
  1) short eval bundle (CSV with 200 retrieval queries + labels)
  2) SSO details + contact for security questionnaire
  3) expected peak qps and average tokens per request
  4) any restricted PII/PHI tagging rules
Arjun: sample config we want them to try in POC (send as starter):
```
model: rw-medium
max_tokens: 512
temperature: 0.0
batch_size: 8
prefix_cache: enabled
```
Sam: for monitoring we'll surface: token breakdown, per-route p95/p50, embedding recall over time, and a prompt drift metric.
Dana: timeline suggestion:
  - Day 0 (Mon): kickoff + discovery (1h)
  - Day 1-4: dataset + security paperwork in hand
  - Week 1: baseline runs + initial evals
  - Week 2: tuning (prompt, caching, batching)
  - Week 3: stability & perf runs + handover doc
  - End of Week 4: success review and decision
Olivia: blockers we should call out to customer now:
  - if SSO takes >2 weeks, cannot do automated sign-in for POC
  - if data residency/legal needs an on-prem package, timeline extends (need Private deployment conversation)
  - heavy throughput may require Dedicated short-term reservation
Priya: customer ask about custom models / quantization? We can bring applied-ML consult in week1 if they want quantized footprint.
Arjun: evaluation: we'll run automatic metrics + 10 human annotators for clinical QA (provide rubric). Need to confirm budget for human evals.
Olivia: meeting agenda draft for Mon 10am:
  - 5m intros
  - 15m discovery (infra + security)
  - 20m use-case walk-through + success metrics
  - 10m POC plan + timeline
  - 10m open Qs / next steps
Dana: who owns follow-ups? Olivia + Priya to sync on security + pricing. Arjun owns eval instrumentation. Sam owns observability dashboard setup.
Olivia: assigning action items now — I'll ping contacts and send pre-read bundle today. :thumbsup:
Priya: I'll prepare a simplified pricing comparison (hosted credits vs 1-week dedicated burst) by EOD Fri.
Arjun: I'll draft eval rubric and quick script to compute recall/precision on their CSV.
Sam: I'll assemble a lightweight dashboard template and share a screenshot before kickoff.
sec-bot: reminder scheduled: "sec questionnaire due" in 4 days -> @Olivia @Priya
Olivia: thanks all — please flag anything missing.
Priya: nothing from me, looks good.
Dana: adding note: ask customer about retention purge SLA for POC data.
Olivia: will add to pre-reads. See you Monday.
